html:
The Chapra are a small Indigenous people of the Amazon lowlands of northern Peru, in Loreto, along the Chapuli and nearby rivers west of the Pastaza.

They speak a dialect of the Kandozi-Chapra language, an isolate shared with the Kandozi, their close kin. They live by fishing, hunting and farming in the swampy forest. Neighbours include the Shawi and the Awajún.
